title: SalesRegisterRow
description: One row of the Sales register in SUNAT PLE format 14.1 (Registro de Ventas e Ingresos, book code 140100), structure of RS 108-2020/SUNAT Annex IV, 35 fields in order. FR-37 to FR-39, FR-41. Each property cites its PLE field number; the UBL origin of every field is in regulatory-matrix.md §I. The TXT export writes the fields in this order separated by '|'.

period.description: PLE 14.1 field 1. Period of the entry, from cbc:IssueDate.

issueDate.description: PLE 14.1 field 4. cbc:IssueDate. Exported as DD/MM/AAAA.

dueDate.description: PLE 14.1 field 5. cbc:DueDate or the last cac:PaymentTerms/cbc:PaymentDueDate. Mandatory in PLE only for document type 14; filled when it exists.

documentType.description: PLE 14.1 field 6. Table 10 (same codes as Catalog 01 for 01, 03, 07, 08).

number.description: PLE 14.1 field 8. Number of cbc:ID, without leading zeros required.

finalNumber.description: PLE 14.1 field 9. Only for daily consolidation of sales receipts; ABC registers every document individually, so it is empty.

exportValue.description: PLE 14.1 field 13. TaxSubtotal with tax 9995 (export). 0.00 in ABC's scope.

taxedBase.description: PLE 14.1 field 14. TaxSubtotal tax 1000 cbc:TaxableAmount (does not include ISC).

taxedBaseDiscount.description: PLE 14.1 field 15. cac:AllowanceCharge with reason 02 (global discount affecting the base).

igv.description: PLE 14.1 field 16. TaxSubtotal tax 1000 cbc:TaxAmount (IGV + IPM).

ivapBase.description: PLE 14.1 field 21. Rice (IVAP, tax 1016); out of ABC's scope, 0.00.

ivap.description: PLE 14.1 field 22. Rice (IVAP); out of ABC's scope, 0.00.

otherCharges.description: PLE 14.1 field 24. TaxSubtotal tax 9999 + cbc:ChargeTotalAmount (outside the taxable base).

totalAmount.description: PLE 14.1 field 25. cac:LegalMonetaryTotal/cbc:PayableAmount; negative for credit notes.

currency.description: PLE 14.1 field 26. cbc:DocumentCurrencyCode (Table 4 = ISO 4217, same as Catalog 02).

exchangeRate.description: PLE 14.1 field 27. SUNAT exchange rate of the issue date; 1.000 for PEN.

modifiedDocument.description: PLE 14.1 fields 28 to 31. Mandatory when documentType is 07 or 08. Source: cac:BillingReference/cac:InvoiceDocumentReference.

issueDate.description: Field 28. Issue date of the modified document.

contractId.description: PLE 14.1 field 32. Only for consortia/joint ventures; empty for ABC.

exchangeRateError.description: PLE 14.1 field 33. '1' if the exchange rate differs from SUNAT's for the date; otherwise empty.

paidWithPaymentMeans.description: PLE 14.1 field 34. '1' if the document was paid with a payment means of Table 1; otherwise empty.

entryStatus.description: PLE 14.1 field 35. Derived from the SUNAT status and the period (regulatory-matrix.md §I).

sunatStatus.description: Internal, not exported to the TXT: used by FR-39 to flag and exclude documents.
